title: R-512 minimal-form normal-contraction and conservativity contract
purpose: Test the Markov/Dirichlet property of the exact R-512 minimal closed form. This is a target-semigroup structural result, not the missing finite-to-anchored-n convergence theorem.

fixed_scope.functional_and_rates: Exactly the PAH-001 functional and the original directed PH/LK/AP rates inherited by R-511; no new move, rate, counterterm or averaging.
fixed_scope.state: The R-510 local-state Hilbert completion and the R-512 minimal closed form Ebar obtained from the exact R-511 pre-form.
fixed_scope.domain: R-511's bounded gauge-invariant globally amplitude-l1-Lipschitz finite-prefix cylinder domain D, with constants included; its form closure is the R-512 domain.
fixed_scope.form_identity: E(f,f)=(1/2) sum_r nu_infty[c_r (f composed with T_r - f)^2] on D, with finite local sums and nonnegative conductances.
fixed_scope.normal_contractions: A map eta:R->R with eta(0)=0 and |eta(a)-eta(b)|<=|a-b|. The canonical Markov truncation is eta_01(a)=min(1,max(0,a)).
fixed_scope.time: The associated R-512 spectral semigroup T_min(t)=exp(-t K_min) uses only the original external stochastic Markov parameter; no physical-time interpretation.
fixed_scope.limit_order: No j or n limit is taken in this contract. The result concerns only the already-constructed R-512 minimal closed form and its associated semigroup.

question: Does the exact R-512 minimal closed form inherit the normal-contraction inequality and therefore define a conservative Markov semigroup, without supplying the missing finite-to-anchored-n identification?

derivation.pointwise: For every root r and f in D, |eta(f composed with T_r)-eta(f)|<=|f composed with T_r-f|, hence each weighted square in E(eta composed with f,eta composed with f) is no larger than the corresponding square in E(f,f).
derivation.domain_stability: D is stable under eta composed with a cylinder: boundedness, finite-prefix dependence, gauge invariance and the global amplitude-l1 Lipschitz constant are preserved.
derivation.closure_passage: If f_k is form-norm Cauchy in D, the same pointwise inequality makes eta composed with f_k form-norm Cauchy; the R-512 minimal completion therefore contains eta composed with every closure vector and preserves the inequality.
derivation.conservativity: The constant one belongs to D, has zero exact form energy, and the closed-form Markov theorem gives T_min(t)1=1 together with positivity and L-infinity contraction. This identifies structural properties of the target semigroup only.

closed_scoped_claim: Conditional on the exact inherited R-511 form identity, D stability and the R-512 minimal form construction, Ebar is a Dirichlet form: every normal contraction is form-contracting, and T_min is positivity preserving, L-infinity contractive and conservative.
assumptions: The source-pinned R-511 weighted-root form identity and nonnegative finite local conductance sums hold at their registered scopes.
The bounded gauge-invariant finite-prefix cylinder domain is stable under the displayed normal contractions.
The R-512 form completion and its associated nonnegative self-adjoint operator are the exact target already fixed by PAH-OMC-019.
The standard closed-Dirichlet-form implication from normal contractions and 1 in the form domain is used only after these PAH-specific hypotheses are checked.
missing_assumptions: No source-authorized U_n/common-Hilbert realization for the varying finite spaces.
No N2b weak-liminf/recovery theorem, N2c/N4 boundary-escape estimate or N2d finite-to-R-512 identification.
No construction or uniqueness theorem for an infinite-volume jump process beyond the spectral semigroup associated with Ebar.
The measure-theoretic construction of the R-510 state and full closed-form theorem remain inherited analytic inputs, not formalized by Lean.

adversarial_review.objection: A finite root-square inequality is being promoted to the full closed form without checking the domain.
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED under the pinned D-stability premise; the contraction is first proved on D and then passed through the form norm, while the inherited measure/form identity remains explicitly conditional.

adversarial_review.objection: Dirichlet form structure proves finite-to-anchored-n semigroup convergence.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AGAINST PROMOTION: normal contraction and conservativity concern the already-selected R-512 target only; N2a-N2d and the ordered temporal limit remain open.

adversarial_review.objection: Conservativity of T_min constructs a unique infinite-volume jump process.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AGAINST PROMOTION: the result is spectral closed-form structure and does not prove path-space existence, non-explosion uniqueness or equality with a maximal jump process.

adversarial_review.objection: eta(0)=0 is unnecessary or the Lipschitz constant can exceed one.
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: eta(0)=0 is part of the normal-contraction convention for Markov forms, and the hostile lane rejects a 2-Lipschitz mutation by an exact energy increase.

adversarial_review.objection: Markov time can be read as physical or Lorentzian time.
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: only the preregistered external stochastic parameter is retained.

single_next_question: Can a source-authorized comparison/process packet establish N2b liminf, N2c/N4 boundary escape and N2d equality with this now-Markov R-512 target without changing PAH-001?
non_claims: No finite-j or anchored-n semigroup convergence, common U_n, Mosco liminf/recovery or minimal-form identification from finite spaces.
No path-space existence, non-explosion, uniqueness, maximal jump-domain equality, spectral gap or ergodicity theorem.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, event horizon, QFT, gravity, Yang-Mills, continuum, mass-gap or TOE conclusion.
External Markov time is not quantum real time, proper time or Lorentzian time; no Q3LOCK or TECT-YM import.

lean.scope: Real scalar normal-contraction, truncation and finite weighted-edge form inequalities; no PAH measure construction or temporal limit.
